findings.title: Live coach evidence and prompts retain seat-0-relative identities
reproduction: Load product-004/records/role_rotation-2.json and buildDecisionReviews with humanSeat=1, moves=[4].
Viewer team is 1 and stageTeam is 0, so the stage relation must be 对方.
Actual evidence fact is '级牌口径=stage（台上=我方）；双方级数 2/2'.
renderFactCards repeats the wrong 我方 relation.
acceptCoachResponse accepts a report reproducing that wrong program fact.
The same failure occurs for role_rotation-4, viewerSeat=3.
For role_rotation-3, viewerSeat=2, the prompt calls the selected viewer '北(队友)'.
findings.impact: Wrong relative identities reach the real VerifiedReportTab evidence/prompt path and can survive the acceptance gate. This violates C1's four-seat identity and zero factual mismatch requirement.
findings.denominatorExplanation: The 1440 checks validate DecisionFactsV3 absolute fields and deliberately null advice. They do not validate these separate live DecisionReview facts or coach prompt roles.
findings.requiredResolution: Correct viewer-relative team and seat rendering throughout actual evidence, prompt and report paths; verify all four viewers without changing the locked denominator.

rawRecomputation.method: Independent temporary script reconstructed states with engine primitives and checked raw moves, cards, text, roles, observation vectors/hashes and applicability. It did not call buildDecisionFactsV3 or verifyProductCard.
rawRecomputation.denominatorDecision: Nonempty fixed denominators and applicability witnesses satisfy the finite DecisionFactsV3 assertion contract. They do not establish full C1 acceptance because the live report path has the P1 mismatch above.

coverageAssessment.developmentStatus: All cases are development engineering cases, not independent tactical samples or sealed skills.
coverageAssessment.tacticalBoundary: The ten categories provide factual scene coverage. Necessary takeover, successful blocking and strategic plan quality are not established labels. Some block_finish roots pass; plan_invalidated roots encode an opponent-control hypothesis rather than a validated multi-step plan. C1 explicitly permits facts without strong strategy labels, so this is a limitation, not a separate strategy-evidence blocker.
coverageAssessment.fourFiveWitnesses: Three retained-five straight-use witnesses and three five-card immediate-finish witnesses recompute correctly. Their explicit local scopes do not establish team optimality.
coverageAssessment.causality: Checked observations contain actor-owned cards, causal public prefixes and preceding transfers. Future outcomes are not used as strategy labels.
coverageAssessment.examples: 13 deterministic category/index selections: three each for yield, takeover, remaining_structure and plan_invalidated, plus evidence_insufficient-1. Baseline actions match saved old-policy greedy rankings; candidate actions are null. These examples originate from product-002; six yield/takeover records differ from product-004 and must remain separately attributed.
coverageAssessment.originalIncident: Original screenshot inspected. screenshot_only status is preserved; hub-ui-1 and constructed regressions are explicitly different records.
